#{Adopt an adaptive multi-edge Guided Local Search penalization scheme by selecting tour edges exceeding an 85% maximum-utility threshold and above average cost to force multi-edge topological escapes without loop overhead.}#

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    
    # Select high-utility edges using an adaptive broadband threshold coupled with an above-average edge cost filter
    threshold = 0.85 * max_utility
    selected_mask = (utilities >= threshold) & (tour_lengths >= avg_edge)
    
    # Fallback to the maximum utility edge if no edges satisfy both conditions
    if not np.any(selected_mask):
        selected_mask = utilities >= (0.99 * max_utility)
        
    penalty = 0.3 * avg_edge
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    
    return updated_edge_distance
